entities.name: Rashtrakuta Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Rashtrakuta Empire, a political institution in India during Regional Kingdoms and Temple Age (550–1070). Grew from Rajput and Harsha and Early Medieval North. Led to the emergence of Deccan and South Indian Dynasties and Chola Maritime Empire.
